title: MNP XH05A ZHAO YUN
summary: Yet nothing is perfect, especially when it is cheap, or at least cheaper than most of the market. The snapfits I found worse than Nezha and Baiqi. There are times I had troubles putting the parts together in various places. Be careful or you would break those tiny bits. The design is not for everyone, too. Zhao Yun looks busy with so many colors and details that you might not even see him properly as a "humanoid" but a bunch of armors.
body: Yet nothing is perfect, especially when it is cheap, or at least cheaper than most of the market. The snapfits I found worse than Nezha and Baiqi. There are times I had troubles putting the parts together in various places. Be careful or you would break those tiny bits. The design is not for everyone, too. Zhao Yun looks busy with so many colors and details that you might not even see him properly as a "humanoid" but a bunch of armors.

Regardless, the quality is still above average comparing to other brands in the market. And you can play around with both of them in different ways, or use the horse for your other model kits. Not the PGU though. SHAME! It's also newbie friendly as there are no gimmicks that would spoil your experience, provided that you are not afraid of too many runners, lol.

If you have the other MNP, then this is unskippable. If you don't, you can start with this one. If you were looking for a break from gundam, you can grab one. It's a beautiful display coming in a fair price.
